import re
import sys

values = {}
pattern = re.compile(r"\s*(a|b|c|d|TMP)\s*<-\s*([A-Za-z]+|-?\d+)\s*;\s*")

for line in sys.stdin:
    line = line.split("//", 1)[0]
    match = pattern.fullmatch(line)
    if match:
        target, source = match.groups()
        values[target] = int(source) if source.lstrip("-").isdigit() else values[source]

print(
    f"a ?= {values['a']}; b ?= {values['b']}; "
    f"c ?= {values['c']}; d ?= {values['d']}; TMP ?= {values['TMP']};"
)
